summary: Volume discount change has four functional defects.

findings.title: Discount tier boundary uses > instead of >=
findings.problem: A cart with exactly 10 items gets no discount; the contract says exactly 10 gets 10%. Off-by-one at the boundary.

findings.title: average_unit_price divides by zero on an empty cart
findings.problem: len(lines) is 0 for an empty cart so ZeroDivisionError is raised.
findings.current_code: return sum(line.unit_price for line in lines) / len(lines)

findings.title: Tax applied before discount
findings.problem: Tax is computed on the pre-discount subtotal, contradicting the documented contract that tax is charged on the discounted amount.
findings.suggested_fix: discounted = subtotal(lines) * (1 - discount_rate(lines)); return round(discounted * (1 + tax_rate), 2)

findings.title: Broad except returns 0.0
findings.problem: Any exception is swallowed and a zero total returned, which looks like a free order.
